Dengue: 3 more die, 882 hospitalised in 24 hours

Staff Correspondent, Dhaka

At least three more people have died of dengue in the 24 hours to 8am Tuesday, taking this year's death toll to 239.

During the period, 882 more patients were hospitalised with the mosquito-borne disease, the Directorate General of Health Services, or DGHS, said in a statement.

Of the new patients, 231 were in Dhaka division (excluding city corporation areas), 98 in Chattogram division, 110 in Barishal division, 70 in Khulna division, 50 in Rajshahi division, 10 in Rangpur division, 40 in Mymensingh division and 3 in Sylhet division.

Some 120 patients were admitted in Dhaka North City Corporation and 150 in Dhaka South City Corporation.

Two of the deaths were recorded in Dhaka South City Corporation and one in Barishal division.

So far this year, 77,672 people have been hospitalised with dengue. In September alone, 21,004 people were admitted and 86 died.
